params.body:
## Summary
- On the vehicle sheet's "Prijzen" step, "BTW-wagen" and "Aankoopprijs" sat with almost no gap on a phone (390px). Root cause: the two `.ui-form-grid` blocks on this step have `margin-bottom: 0`, so the only thing separating them was the BTW note's own `margin: 8px 0 4px` — and that margin disappears entirely once the note gets `d-none` (BTW-wagen answered "nee", or not yet answered).
- Wrapped the BTW fields, the note, and the price fields in one `.ui-price-step` flex column with a steady `gap: 20px`. A flex `gap` is skipped around a `display:none` child instead of shrinking to nothing, so the rhythm between field groups stays the same whether the note renders or not, at every width.
- Verified at 390px with BTW-wagen = "nee" (the reported case) and 1440px. At 1440 the fix adds a small, deliberate gap (~20px) where a 3-column grid row previously left an incidental ~13px of stretch space; visually it reads the same, just slightly more even.

## Screenshots
- `.playwright-mcp/prices-spacing/before-390.png` / `after-390.png` — phone, BTW-wagen "nee"
- `.playwright-mcp/prices-spacing/before-1440.png` / `after-1440.png` — desktop

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='VehicleForm|Price|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` — 140 tests, 1452 assertions, green
- [x] Screenshots at 390px and 1440px, before and after
